macros.name: AtBeginOfIncludeFile
macros.doc: The 〈code〉 is only executed for the file with the given 〈file name〉 and only if it is read using \include.

macros.name: AtEndOfEveryFile
macros.doc: Sometime certain code should be executed at the begin and end of every read file, e.g. pushing and popping a file stack.
